item.title: Lion vs Crocodile Animal Survival: What Science Says About the Odds
item.description:
Lion vs crocodile: who wins when an African lion meets a Nile crocodile at the water's edge? We break down the biomechanics, terrain and odds behind this predator vs predator rivalry in animal survival.
Lions and Nile crocodiles share rivers across much of Africa, and encounters at the water's edge keep drawing attention from field observers and researchers. In this episode of the Lion vs Crocodile Files, we look at what decides these animal fights: leverage on land, water depth, ambush timing and numbers. The result depends on the ground they meet on, not just on which animal is stronger.
